scope: Second, extended U-Boot RAM run of the unchanged two-core kernel

observations.dual_core: Both CPUs online through 351 seconds; CPU1-pinned SHA256 ran for 20 seconds with CPU1 user ticks increasing 414 to 2363
observations.thermal: CPU thermal samples reached at most 60.255 C during CPU1 load and returned to 55.672 C
observations.watchdog: Linux nowayout 120-second watchdog stayed feeding; pings reached at least 69
observations.ethernet: Direct Ethernet remained up; isolated DHCP 10.77.10.10/24 and rescue 10.77.10.11/24 both present; DHCP server advertises no router or DNS
observations.audio: Two concurrent packaged 48 kHz silent ALSA streams exited zero in 9.23 seconds
observations.peripherals: INA3221 voltage/current rows, TMP102 and CPU temperature, LED classes, RTC, OMAP mailbox and hardware spinlock remained readable/bound; board EEPROM SHA256 matched the ram95 record
observations.qt: Same Qt PID 129 throughout recorded observations; no display cycle or Qt restart requested
observations.recovery: Requested reboot restored stock Linux, Phoenix, exact factory p8 and approved ADC postflight in 36.7 seconds

limits: This is a roughly six-minute RAM run, not a long-term soak or production power-management qualification.
DNS and router options were not delivered because the isolated DHCP server intentionally advertises neither.
No display cycling or human touch/brightness interaction was requested in this regression.
CPU frequency, voltage and suspend policy remain disabled or unqualified.
